title: Courier Pickup Checklist
subtitle: Courier Pickup: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Courier Pickup Checklist covers parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff. The courier dispatch coordinator records Courier Pickup criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Courier Pickup Checklist keeps Courier Pickup exceptions visible until the courier dispatch coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Courier Pickup Checklist at pickup address, secure collection point, vehicle, and destination route. Document parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff identity before Courier Pickup begins. Compare parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff findings with stated Courier Pickup criteria; route unresolved Courier Pickup issues to courier operations reviewer.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Courier Pickup, identify responsible parties, pickup address, secure collection point, vehicle, and destination route, and the linked parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff source.

fields.label: Piece, label, tracking, and seal identifiers
Origin, destination, service level, and pickup window

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Courier Pickup facts for parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Courier Pickup finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Courier Dispatch Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Pickup authority or secure access unavailable
Piece and packaging photograph when needed
blocks.guidance: Pause Courier Pickup when content, identity, authority, security, or service-level exception remains unresolved. Retain the available Courier Pickup proof and route unresolved parcel, envelope, service level, pickup window, label, and custody handoff scope to courier dispatch coordinator.
